title: Privacy Policy
description: How Quanto collects, uses, and protects your information. Your expense data stays on your device.
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Quanto (“the App”) collects, uses, and protects your information.

blocks.x: a) We don't collect personal information
Quanto **does not** require users to create an account and **does not** collect personal information such as:
All expense and income data you enter is stored locally on your device.
b) Automatically collected information
We may collect limited, non-personal information through third-party services to help improve app performance, stability, and measure advertising effectiveness, such as:

items: Device identifiers (such as advertising identifiers) used for analytics and advertising attribution

blocks.x: This information is collected through third-party services such as Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, and the Meta (Facebook) SDK and does not directly identify you.
Payments for premium features are processed securely through:
We do not see, collect, or store any payment or credit card information.
Currently:

items: All user-entered data is stored locally on your device only
We do not have access to your data

blocks.x: In the future, optional cloud backup features may be introduced. If so, this policy will be updated accordingly before such features are enabled.
The optional AI features described in section 8 are the exception: when you choose to use one, limited information is sent off your device for processing.
You can delete all your data directly within the app at any time.
If you contact us at [ausejoalejandro@gmail.com](mailto:ausejoalejandro@gmail.com), we will assist with any data-related questions.
Quanto is not directed to children under the age of 13.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.

Quanto uses third-party services to support analytics, diagnostics, and advertising attribution. These services may collect limited information, including device identifiers, in accordance with their own privacy policies.
Third-party services used by the app include:

items: Meta (Facebook) SDK – used for advertising attribution and app install measurement
Google Gemini – used to provide the optional AI features described in section 8

blocks.x: Where required, user consent is requested through Apple’s App Tracking Transparency framework before enabling tracking.
Quanto’s AI features are optional. Nothing described in this section happens unless you choose to use one of them.
a) What is shared
When you choose to use an AI feature:

items: **Voice Transactions:** Your device turns your speech into text. Quanto does not receive or store your voice recording. The text, selected currency, and your category and account names are used to create transaction suggestions.
**Receipt Scanning:** A smaller copy of the receipt image is sent for processing. Location and other hidden image information are removed first.

**PDF Scanning:** Your original PDF is not uploaded. Quanto sends text taken from the document or, when needed, a smaller image of a page. PDF passwords stay on your device and are never sent or stored.

**Apple Pay Automation:** If you set up the optional Apple Shortcuts automation, payment details are saved to Quanto on your device. Most payments are categorized on your device. When Quanto cannot choose a category, only the merchant name and your expense category names are sent for help. The amount, date, card name, and account are not sent.

blocks.x: Quanto does not connect directly to Apple Pay, your bank, or your card provider. It receives Apple Pay details only through the automation you create.
b) How your information is handled
Google Gemini processes the information needed to provide these features. Information sent to Google Gemini through Quanto’s paid service is not used to train Google’s AI models.
Your information is encrypted while being sent. Quanto does not sell it or use it for advertising or tracking.

Quanto does not keep voice recordings, voice transcripts, receipt or PDF content, PDF passwords, or Apple Pay merchant names on its servers. Limited technical records are kept to protect the service, fix problems, and apply feature usage limits. Most of these records are deleted within 90 days, while usage totals may be kept for as long as they are needed to apply those limits.
c) AI results and your choices
AI can make mistakes. Voice, receipt, and PDF results are shown as editable drafts and are saved only after you confirm them.

Apple Pay transactions are saved automatically after you set up the automation, but you can edit them at any time. Correcting a category helps Quanto categorize the same merchant better on your device in the future.
Quanto is an expenses management tool and does not provide financial, accounting, or tax advice. Check important information against the original receipt or document.

You can stop using these features at any time. You can also remove camera, photo, microphone, or speech permissions in your device settings. To stop Apple Pay Automation, delete the Quanto automation from Apple’s Shortcuts app.
We take reasonable measures to protect your information. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact:
